column1: # The host-2 campaign published on 2026-11-26 (partial): each results file as the harness wrote it in the
# run named here, copied unchanged; machine.txt concatenates the machine blocks of these runs. See

# Not published here: the hard tier of bench G (G_groebner_hard_giac.tsv, G_groebner_hard_grobx.tsv, G_groebner_hard_groebner.tsv, G_groebner_hard_macaulay2.tsv, G_groebner_hard_msolve.tsv, G_groebner_hard_sage_giac.tsv, G_groebner_hard_sage_singular.tsv, G_groebner_hard_sympy.tsv), whose result column holds the
# full bases (up to 104 MB a file, over GitHub's file and Pages limits); they are kept with their checksums in
# the review archive of 2026-11-25 (docs/methodology.md), and their basis digests are summarised there.
# Reruns of 2026-11-26 not published here, kept with their checksums in the review archive: bench F cases 615 to 630
# (615 a warm-up) for Giac.jl, Symbolics.jl, SymPy, SymJ.jl, Maxima and the Compute Engine, files of a case range that
# the full files would double (the Maxima range is superseded by its full rerun at 73f1ea4); the hard tier of bench G
# for Giac.jl and Sage/Giac on one Giac thread (over GitHub's limits, as above); FriCAS F and H at 0c0d15a,
# superseded by its rerun at 73f1ea4. machine.txt has the blocks of the published files only.
# Bench E was replaced on 2026-11-28 by a suite written for this repository; the files of the earlier suite are
# withdrawn from results/ (they stay in the git history and the review archive).
# Published under a neutral host name (tools/anonymize_host.py): sha256 is the checksum of the published file, sha256_as_written that of the file the run wrote.
